commits.summary: Pin the starting locale of the initializer mutation control
commits.body: The JVM on this host starts in en. The control correctly refused the locale change, but its diagnostic check expected a transition from en-US. Set the fixture JVM's language and country so that both ends of the transition are reproducible. The targeted observed_countermodels test failed before the change and now passes.

commits.body:
Seven existing array, alias and division cases are selected by exact ID. Record compiled class and oracle digests, checker tree, budget and cache conditions with the phase data for comparison on the integrated checker. The benchmark and timing-reader tests passed. The changed Rust run exposed a host-locale expectation, now pinned and retested separately.

Verification pending in job 20261119-152603-foundation-baseline-on-seven-existing-ar on the pre-change checker. It exercises both engines on the same strict claims.

commits.summary: Expose claim and revision history from the example handoff
commits.body:
Group source claims across subjects while keeping each subject's receipts, traceable jobs, replay tasks and beside-route acceptance. The existing task handoff still works. Import the dated preservation trials for 288, including the slower shared-lemma experiment and the bound-8 retry condition, without changing the frozen sidecar.

The public handoff listed all three source claims, six proof tasks and two replays on 286, and kept 288's preservation open. All 21 affected Python test files passed. Example 288 validation and the Python cost inventory lint passed.

commits.summary: Challenge shared call results at a heap merge (verification pending)
commits.body:
Run the actual absorb operation on two heaps whose string results are numbered in opposite orders. Compare branch-dependent strings and saved array results on the public checker and JVM. The three controls were refuted. The allocation and recursion cases gave named refusals. Replace the old challenge script's allocating positive with a scalar loop that actually uses the rule. A capped probe verified it with 88 related calls.

Verification pending in job 20261119-154132-challenge-i028-and-i029-on-the-shared-ca for the full hand script. The changed Rust suite passed, with one encoding-time test passing on its automatic retry. The focused JVM, native, merge and test-inventory checks passed.

commits.summary: Bind input lengths before accepting a proof and retain its assumptions
commits.body:
Require a length-sensitive beside-route proof to use a bound declared by its frozen claim or task, or the versioned planner default committed in the job's source-claim link. A result cannot supply its own missing bound. Check witness values without counting the number of arguments as an array length. Report the provenance and carry evidence limits and checker assumptions independently into the JSON and text milestone views.

All 51 acceptance tests and all 22 milestone tests passed, including bound drift, replay membership, ordinary defaults and a compatibility check on an existing beside-route task. The human report for 287 now shows the termination assumption on its preservation evidence.

commits.summary: Measure Commons Text LCS on its release bytes and a shared-row control
commits.body:
Example 308 pins the release class, source blob, independent subsequence oracle and mutation patch. On JDK 21 the release JAR and source rebuild agreed on all 225 inputs, while the shared-row control disagreed on 44. Its score on ab and aa changed from 1 to 2. javap confirmed the two-dimensional allocation at offset 18 on each build.

Both ordinary JVM replay tasks passed and published receipts, including 44 mismatches for the altered artifact. The native transfer probe reached the multidimensional allocation and refused it at unwind 18 and array bound 4. Its outcome and measured cost are recorded independently of the frozen claim. The example validator and all four router and contract checks passed.

commits.summary: Isolate submission identity in the pipeline test
commits.body: The test inherited the real Codex thread ID when exercising its synthetic Claude session, so it failed on this worker. Clear both identities in the fixture and cover the actual precedence when a Codex worker inherits a parent session. The formerly failing case and the affected pipeline test file passed.

commits.summary: Qualify JVM settings and modeled error details (verification pending)
commits.body:
The native checker refuses to establish JVM messages and causes from exception details chosen by a JDK model. Class initialization observations refuse the known indirect property reads, dynamic member lookup and unbound CPU, filesystem or charset settings in the initialized classes. The four exception and six initializer countermodels now have named refusals on the checker and independent JVM controls. The changed Rust suite, focused JVM tests and inventory lint passed.

Verification pending in job 20261119-163916-recheck-290-preservation-with-qualified. Of the five frozen comparisons on the challenged checker, 290 alone uses observed initializers. Its preceding outcome recorded eight of them.
